summary.headline: Mutinensis Codices 42 and 85
summary.text: Catalog entries for Mutinensis codices 42 and 85 describe a 12th–13th-century parchment by the monk Gregory and a 15th-century paper manuscript by Michael Suliardus, with ownership by George Valla and Albert Pio. Codex 85 transmits Ptolemy’s Tetrabiblos, its life and prooemium, followed by chapters on the seven planets, benefic and malefic stars, masculine and feminine stars, diurnal and nocturnal stars, configurations to the Sun, fixed stars, and trine configurations.
